5-21-25
Claim received for a low-speed head-on collision. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will
go through the attorney's office.
7-11-25
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision and records the scene as
described on first notice.
7-17-25
Driver conifrmed as a named driver on the policy. Coverage was in force on the date of loss, and nothing in the file
suggests the daamge predates the policy start.
8-18-25
Photos from the scene reviewed. They confirm several key details of the impact, though no independent witnesses
have come forward to add to the account.
8-30-25
Vehicle damage reviewed against the reported impact. The damage pattern matches the described collision, and no
earlier dmaage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records.
9-23-25
Medical records received for a knee injury. The injury is consistent in kind and force with the mechanism of this crash.
10-13-25
Records also show a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully with no ongoing treatment at
that time.
10-20-25
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee injury. The treating provider's notes explain
the course of care, and a medical review has been requested.
11-29-25
Claimant's statement obtained through counsel. Minor details were added sicne the first report, but the core account
of the collision has stayed the same across each telling.
12-5-25
File remains open pending the medical reivew and receipt of the remaining treatment billing. Next follow-up is set with
counsel once those items are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
